title: Galaxy Triplet Arp 274
caption: Galaxy triplet Arp 274, imaged by the Hubble Space Telescope
celestial: Arp 274, NGC 5679 · constellation Virgo · about 400 million light-years away (source figure)
credit: NASA, ESA, M. Livio and the Hubble Heritage Team (STScI/AURA)

recognition.text: NASA Hubble image release (STScI). No published audience rating.

story: Three galaxies appear to overlap in Arp 274, though they may sit at somewhat different distances. The largest, in the middle, looks like a spiral and may be barred. The spiral on the right is strung with bright blue knots of star formation, as is the small, more compact galaxy at far left. The system lies about 400 million light-years away in the constellation Virgo.

Two of the three are making new stars rapidly, while the spiral shapes of two remain mostly intact. Yellowish older stars fill the central bulge of each galaxy, and a bright cluster of stars marks each nucleus. The arms are traced by younger blue stars, alongside pinkish nebulae lit by new star formation, with interstellar dust silhouetted against the stars.
A pair of stars at far right are much closer, inside our own Milky Way. Hubble photographed Arp 274 after the public picked it in a vote held for the International Year of Astronomy.

understand.summary: Taken with Hubble's Wide Field Planetary Camera 2 through blue, visible and infrared filters plus one isolating hydrogen. F673N (redshifted H-alpha) and F814W are shown in red, F606W in green and F450W in blue.
understand.eye: NASA says the colours reflect the natural colours of the different star populations, though the infrared filter records light the eye cannot see.

explore: Arp 274, also known as NGC 5679, won the Space Telescope Science Institute's You Decide competition with 67,021 of the nearly 140,000 votes cast for six candidate targets. The International Year of Astronomy celebrated 400 years since Galileo first turned a telescope to the sky.
sources: NASA release: Hubble Celebrates the International Year of Astronomy with the Galaxy Triplet Arp 274
alt: Three partly overlapping galaxies, a large spiral in the middle, a spiral with blue knots on the right and a compact galaxy at far left.
